playbookOutputs: Retrieved CIPC Statutory Certificates (CoR 14.3 / MOI / CoR 39 as requested)
playbookCommonFailures: CIPC registration number provided does not exist or belongs to a pre-electronic legacy file requiring manual CIPC archive retrieval
Requestor is not listed as an active director when requesting restricted non-public CIPC archive documents
CIPC e-Services / BizPortal document server temporarily offline delaying automated PDF generation

informationToProvide.label: Company Registered Name & CIPC Registration Number
informationToProvide.helpText: Provide the registered company name and CIPC registration number (e.g., 2021/123456/07).

informationToProvide.label: Specific CIPC Documents Requested (e.g., CoR 14.3 Registration Certificate, MOI, CoR 39 Director History, Full Disclosure)
informationToProvide.helpText: Specify which CIPC documents you need retrieved from CIPC records.

informationToProvide.label: ID Copy of Active Director or Authorised Applicant
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload a clear copy of the director or applicant ID to verify authority for retrieving CIPC statutory records.
informationToProvide.aiHint: South African ID or Passport of the director or authorised requestor. Verify legibility of full name and ID number.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect company registration number, requested document list, and director ID
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Company registration number/name, specific documents requested, and requestor ID received
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Confirm which exact CIPC certificates the client needs (e.g., CoR14.3 Registration Certificate, Standard MOI, CoR39 Director Amendments, or Full Corporate Disclosure Certificate).

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify company registration details and director authority
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Company enterprise number verified and requestor identity checked against CIPC director records
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Validate the CIPC registration number format (YYYY/NNNNNN/NN) and verify the uploaded ID.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Request and retrieve official company documents on CIPC e-Services / BizPortal
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: CIPC certificate reprint / disclosure request submitted under My Accountant customer code
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Log into CIPC e-Services / New e-Services > Document Reprint / Enterprise Enquiry using the My Accountant customer code. Trigger reprint of CoR14.3, MOI, CoR39, and Corporate Disclosure Certificate for the enterprise number.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Wait for CIPC to email or generate the official certificate PDFs
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Official CIPC PDF certificates received from CIPC
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Check the CIPC customer code email inbox or e-Services download queue for the generated certificates.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver retrieved CIPC company documents to the client portal
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: All requested CIPC documents uploaded to the order Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Verify each PDF matches the client company registration number and post to Communication History with a summary of the company current status and Annual Return due month.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms all requested CIPC documents have been delivered
